description: Start on a populated middle season of The Middle with the season strip focused and artwork loaded. Record season, episode count and horizontal episode position for both builds. Collect unarmed heartbeat/FRAMEDROP during the same alternating LEFT/RIGHT sequence. No activation or acquisition.

steps.name: 01-before
steps.review: Confirm exact season focus, episode count and episode scroll position. Repeat the same scene after installation; initial load and screenshot settling are not performance samples.

steps.name: 02-motion
steps.review: Review smooth motion, continuous glass fade, neighboring focus light and artwork continuity. Compare p50/p95/p99 and slow22 from a separate no-capture timed alternating arrow sequence. Verify new seasons update titles and descriptions without stale layout. Keep shader/source composition identical when attributing gains to layout validation.
